issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type String, while the solution implements getTotalNumberOfStudents() returning int. The problem text also refers students to the UML for the expected return type, which will mislead them into implementing a String return when the intended numerical type is int.
issues.suggestedFix: Correct the UML and any related text in problem_statement.md to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (instead of String), so it matches the intended numeric return type used in the solution and tests. Alternatively, if a String return was intended, update the solution and template to return String consistently and clarify the required format in the specification.
